'''Solace''' was an underground location on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

==History==
This obscure area was located in an old section of the planet, far from the [[Senate District/Legends|Senate District]] and near the old sea level. This place was a refuge for people hiding from the newly-arisen [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The guide of this people was the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Fy-Tor-Ana]], who had survived [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]].

The former [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ferus Olin]], alongside the [[Erased]], came to this place with the help of [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]], in the hopes of reaching Fy-Tor-Ana and regrouping all Jedi who had survived the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]].

Unfortunately, there was a [[Duro (individual)|spy]] in the group, who betrayed them. A [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] [[Battalion/Legends|battalion]] arrived at Solace to either capture the refugees or wipe them all out. With the [[Force power/Legends|abilities]] of the Jedi and the Erased members, they managed to escape, but the other inhabitants of Solace were not so lucky.
